title: Baking Soda in Ground Meat: Juicier, Browner Beef and Turkey Burgers (Chili and Skillet Turkey Burgers)
summary: The video demonstrates a simple, evidence-backed technique: treating ground meat with a small amount of baking soda dissolved in water to keep it juicy, tender, and better browned. Through beef chili and turkey burgers, the host explains dosing per pound, dispersal methods to avoid clumps, and the science behind why the alkaline treatment changes protein interactions to retain moisture and foster browning. The beef chili example shows a two-pound batch with specific soda and salt amounts, aromatics, and a long, gentle oven braise to finish the dish, while the turkey burgers emphasize a cold-start method with minimal handling and a binder-rich mix for a juicy patty. The segment ends with tasting and a takeaway that the baking soda trick can improve any ground-meat recipe.
topics: ground beef treatment with baking soda
deglazing and flavor extraction from fond
Turkey burger technique with baking soda
binders and flavor boosters (soy, butter, panko, parm, gelatin)
app promotion for ATK skillet turkey burgers

sections.title: Intro & Ground Beef Soda Prep
concepts: baking soda as a universal tenderizer
dissolving soda in water for even distribution
sections.description: Intro to the baking soda trick for ground meat, with a practical method: dissolve 3/4 teaspoon baking soda and 1.5 teaspoons salt in 2 tablespoons water, then mix with two pounds of beef to evenly disperse the solution before cooking.

sections.title: Disperse Soda & Salt in Ground Beef
sections.description: The cook explains dissolving the soda in water to prevent clumps and ensure even contact with the meat, enabling fast, thorough distribution before cooking begins.

sections.title: Browning & Fond: How Baking Soda Changes Protein Interactions
sections.description: Discussion of how baking soda shifts charged regions in protein chains, reducing tight cross-linking and helping retain juices, which supports browning and a meaty fond when searing.

sections.title: Beef Chili: Browning, Aromatics, and Fond Development
sections.description: Beef is browned with the treated mixture to form a flavorful fond. Aromatics are added, followed by the spice blend; the fond will flavor the chili as it progresses toward braising.

sections.title: Chili Finishing & Oven Braise Setup
concepts: long, gentle cook for beef clarity
sections.description: The base is completed with deglazing and liquid integration, then the pot goes into a 275°F oven for a slow ~90-minute braise to finish the chili.

sections.title: Turkey Burger: Baking Soda Method & Cold-Start Cooking
concepts: cold start cooking to prevent contraction
sections.description: A separate demonstration shows ground turkey treated with baking soda (1/8 tsp soda, 1 tsp water), broken into pieces, lightly tossed with binders (soy sauce, melted butter, panko, parmesan, gelatin, salt, pepper), formed into patties, and cooked on a cold skillet over medium heat with a lid until done. Emphasis on avoiding overworking meat and the benefits of a cold-start for juicy burgers.

sections.title: Wrap-Up & Resources
sections.description: Final remarks reinforce that baking soda improves any ground-meat application and points viewers to the ATK app for more details and variations.
